kpi.multiCourse_one: {{count}} student joined more than one course
kpi.multiCourse_other: {{count}} students joined more than one course
kpi.feesSub: Fee plans of these admissions, after discount
kpi.collectedSub: Paid as a share of fees

footnotes.mainCourse: A student who joined several courses at once is counted once, under the course whose group comes first in Settings → Reports → Course group order (else the course they were enrolled in first). Course groups are course tags.
footnotes.fieldHint: Pick the field to break admissions down by (for example Branch) in Settings → Reports → Admissions field.
footnotes.definitions: An admission is a student enrolled in a month of the selected period. Fees are their fee plans for those enrolments (cancelled, voided and waived instalments left out); paid is what has been collected on them so far; due is fees minus paid.
